description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Deep Learning Based Estimation of Peak Wind Pressures on Buildings from Short Duration Measurements is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Matthew DeJong, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project presents a deep learning model to predict peak wind pressures experienced on vertical building surfaces from statistical features extracted from short durations of boundary-layer wind tunnel data with varying wind conditions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-nwcb-r259. Keywords: NHERI SimCenter; Deep Learning; Machine Learning; Peak Wind Pressures; Neural Networks. Published 2023-08-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
